title: Night of the Devils
writer: Eduardo Manzanos, Romano Migliorini, Gianbattista Mussetto
actors: Gianni Garko, Agostina Belli, Roberto Maldera
plot: The patriarch of a wealthy family fears that he will show up one day in vampire form. Should this happen, he warns his family to not let him back into his house, no matter how much he begs them.
